title: Philippines BPO Workforce Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily team-level activity from 40 synthetic agent teams of a fictional Philippine BPO into workforce and service KPIs, 7-day staffing-gap risk scores, unplanned absence anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Event-free contact rate, workforce events logged, staffing-gap events and PHP labour cost for 40 agent teams in Makati City, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City and Bacolod City.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to team-day rows. There are no agent-level records.
The event-type chart shows which workforce events leave teams understaffed and which are always absorbed, such as typhoon site closures.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of workforce KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which teams should the real-time desk watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each team's probability of a staffing-gap event in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags unplanned absence outliers per team, and the forecast projects company-wide workforce-event volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are quality calibration and training keeping up?

talking_points: QA calibration compliance, compliance training coverage and pending certifications frame the readiness gaps.
QA calibration compliance against staffing-gap events by team shows where missed reviews and staffing gaps move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, team, event-type and risk tables only.
show: QA calibration compliance and training coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a team falls behind its interval forecast right now?

talking_points: Live interval staffing events land in RAW.LIVE_STAFFING_EVENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs GAP events with an SOP hint and the team's current risk band, then emails the on-call real-time analyst.
tabs.call_out: From staffing gap to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic staffing-response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic, team-level demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
